excerpt: ALICE (A Large Ion Collider Experiment) is studying the physics of strongly interacting matter, and in particular the properties of the Quark-Gluon Plasma (QGP), using proton-proton, proton-nucleus and nucleus-nucleus collisions at the CERN LHC (Large Hadron Collider).
publisher: ALICE Collaboration / IOP Publishing (J. Phys. G)
title: Technical Design Report for the Upgrade of the ALICE Inner Tracking System
